name: dsh-diagrams
description: Diagrams (row `dsh-diagrams`, tab kinds `diagram` / `diagrams`): Mermaid and TikZ LaTeX diagrams as a first-class vn-harness surface. The model gets five tools (diagram_write/patch/read/verify/delete) that validate every diagram on the host - Mermaid is parsed headlessly by the same vendored engine the browser renders with, TikZ is compiled by the machine's own TeX engine - and the verdict comes back with line-accurate diagnostics plus advisory warnings about what will not read well. Nothing the engine builds can reach the page: mermaid renders behind parse-first validation with its own error drawing suppressed and a container the plugin owns, so a broken source is text and never a 'Syntax error in text' picture. The browser reports back what it actually drew, so the model can verify a picture exists rather than just that the source parses. Plus two bundled skills that teach Mermaid and TikZ craft. Each diagram becomes a real right-bar tab with a rendered view, a source drawer and an export menu, and every tool call renders the diagram inline in the conversation. State is per-conversation and survives restarts; artifacts are content-addressed and cached. No core patches, no fork, no npm dependencies, no network. Alpha.
